correctness.rationale: For every Boolean team, a split satisfying two unary dependencies extends to total functions f,g and hence to one of sixteen 12-row maximal model envelopes. Their four-row complements produce an exact finite transversal characterization. The nine explicit masks under the 32-coordinate symmetry group produce 132 distinct minimal transversals; the complete 65536-mask certificate proves no others. Independent 2-SAT reachability and maximal-envelope enumeration reproduce 32377 satisfying teams and minimal-size counts 12,16,96,8 at sizes 4,5,6,8. The irreducible size-eight orbit proves sharpness. Three included checker files were run successfully. Computation is exhaustive only for the fixed finite Boolean domain; no general-domain size claim is inferred.

value.rationale: The formula is the canonical example of globally incoherent disjunctions of independent unary functional dependencies. Fixing the smallest nontrivial value domain asks for its complete hereditary binary-data integrity obstruction system: exactly sixteen maximal admissible tables versus 132 minimal forbidden tables, nine irreducible symmetry types, and a sharp eight-row local test instead of the trivial sixteen-row bound. The exact obstruction spectrum and dual maximal envelopes are natural objects for finite model checking, integrity constraint design, and assessing domain-restricted coherence. This value does not depend on a general theorem beyond the finite Boolean case.
